page.overview:
Who is Theophilus?

Theophilus was the butler of the Janusian Faithful.

Theophilus travelled to Arrakis alongside the Janusian Faithful, which included Phaedra Vye, Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Roella Ramsby, Oona Byrn, Venesir Ask, Bianca Bagetti, Eulalia Harthorn, Hesperia Farani and Ansel Virro. He served the group at their secretive gatherings.

Theophilus was on duty at a banquet attended by Harthorn, Virro, Yimari, Ramsby, Byrn and Bagetti, during which several of the nobles present died from drinking poisoned wine. He was approached by the Prisoner and advised them to talk to Harthorn, who still drew breath. They later returned and asked him why there had been a placement change for Yimari, to which he replied that she had been alergic to a species of planet in the flower arrangement. They asked about the seating plan, but he stated that it had been destroyed by wine spilled by a drunken noble. They later asked him of a note that he had passed to Ramsby on behalf of Ambrose Lucifera, for whom he expressed his dislike.
